meta.machine: DGX Station, one GB300 (256,703 MiB), DGX OS 7.6.0, driver 610.43.02, CUDA 13.3
meta.measured: 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19 (UTC), one machine, most cells once
meta.benchmark: Garner McCloud's bench_full.py: fixed code prompt (2.6K in, 2,048 out, greedy, one warm-up then 5 runs), GSM8K windows of 60 s (T=1.0, thinking on), prefill on uncached prompts, GSM8K-200, needles, tool call. Mixed prompts: James Meadlock's two sets of 20 prompts (greedy, thinking off).
meta.unit: output tokens per second unless stated
notes: A two-value entry is the lowest and highest value across boots (or passes) of the same config.
code_1user is the median of 5 timed runs in a session; a range is two or three session medians.
Stream rows for this recipe are one 60 s window in a full-scoreboard session; for the public recipe they are the mean of two warmed passes; for SGLang the mean of two passes counted at the client.

Stock vLLM stream rows were run once, with no warm-up rounds first, and read 14 percent under the numbers published for that config (326 and 584). Stock runs at most 24 requests at once, so at 32 users 8 wait.
The engine adapts its resident experts to the traffic. All numbers are settled speeds on prompts that were also used to warm up, except the held_out_1m block.

ttft_ms.title: Time to first token, code prompt (ms)

code_prompt_steps.note: Fixed code prompt, one full-scoreboard session each: tokens per second = tokens per step x steps per second. Source: the fixed-prompt row of each raw scoreboard; the fixed-3 row is cell k1f3f in results/logs/gtq13-run.log.

short_request_burst_262k.note: James Meadlock's A5 cells on the 262K profile, three passes: 40 short requests 8 at a time, and 64 short requests 32 at a time. Source: results/logs/gtq12-run.log, cell a5f262.

held_out_1m.note: Default profile, a boot with no warm-up rounds (cell ho1m in results/logs/gtq22-run.log). Prompt set A was run three times, then set B, which the server had not seen. One user, tok/s, with the share of expert picks that were cold.

stage_skip_pair_1m.note: Default profile with the stage skip patch in the tree, switched off (cell sk0_1m) and on (sk1_1m), same measurements in the same order. Source: results/logs/gtq22-run.log. Both gave 40 of 40 identical outputs.

soak_1m.note: Default profile, four rounds of about 53 minutes (cell soak1m in results/logs/gtq21-run.log): 10-minute windows at 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 users with long uncached prompts arriving throughout, 1 skip in 200 compared byte for byte. tok/s per round.

two_gpu_reference.label: Station with an RTX PRO 6000 added (Garner McCloud, published, not measured by us)

capacity_variants.note: Packed 6-bit scale banks (experimental patch, off by default): 2 to 5 percent slower at 2 to 32 users in one session each, and a larger context cache.
